about: Hand-labelled talk edges for games/game_00000.jsonl, standing in for each player's extraction call when the game is replayed with avalon.replay. Sources are transcript seq numbers of the speaker's own utterances. Only clear accusations and defenses are labelled; questions and hedges are left out.
